benchmark-overview.webp.alt: Benchmark results for Kimi K3.1 Pro and peer models across 14 coding, science, and knowledge-work evaluations

benchcad.webp.alt: BenchCAD results (1,000-file subset, Voxel IoU): with tools, Claude Opus 5.5 scores 96.2, GPT-6 Astra 95.9, Kimi K3.1 Pro 92.7, Claude Fable 5.1 92.6, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 81.6; without tools, Claude Opus 5.5 scores 73.0, Kimi K3.1 Pro 72.8, Claude Fable 5.1 60.6, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 41.2

3d-make.webp.alt: The Kimi 3D Make interface on kimi.com, with a prompt box for turning ideas into 3D models and featured templates including a pagoda, a typewriter, and a jet engine

finance.webp.alt: Finance benchmark results for OfficeQA Pro v2 and Frontier Finance, with Kimi K3.1 Pro leading OfficeQA Pro v2 at 64.4 and scoring 58.6 on Frontier Finance against Claude, GPT, GLM, and DeepSeek models

internal-finance.webp.alt: Internal Finance Benchmark: Kimi K3.1 Pro versus K3 on Internal Finance Modeling (57.6 vs 50.4), Internal Financial Research (70.4 vs 58.8), and Internal Business Operation (37 vs 8.9)

hallucination.webp.alt: Kimi Hallu Bench claim-level hallucination rates (lower is better): without tools, GPT-6 Astra 4.2, Kimi K3.1 Pro 5.4, Opus 5.5 6.8, Fable 5.1 11.4, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 13.1, GLM-5.3 14.8; Hard with tools, GPT-6 Astra 5.5, Kimi K3.1 Pro 8.3, Opus 5.5 15.0, GLM-5.3 22.6, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 23.3, Fable 5.1 23.3

cyber.webp.alt: Internal xdev-bench-hard (pass@3) results: GPT-5.6 Sol (third-party evaluation) solves 100 problems, the Kimi model without cyber risk-reduction 90.5, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 85.7, Kimi K3.1 Pro 81.0, GLM-5.3 57.1, and Kimi K3 33.3, with average success rate and average tokens per successful trajectory for each
